title: Providers expats compare while working with Dutch recruiters
intro: Working with **recruitment agencies**, **uitzendbureaus** and **intermediairs** often overlaps with **offer modelling**, **visa sponsorship questions**, **relocation timing**, **housing search** and **mandatory setup** once a placement is in play. These listings are for discovery when you need scoped help — not rankings of recruitment agencies, uitzendbureaus or headhunters, and not job placement guarantees. Confirm services, pricing and credentials before you commit.

items.reason: Online Dutch tax filing and payroll context when a recruiter-led offer needs gross-to-net modelling.

Furnished rentals and mid-term housing while you interview via agencies, relocate or start a new role.
